verdict.rationale: Datadog's Bits AI and Watchdog features are documented as delivering AI-generated insights, anomaly detection, and suggestions directly within the platform's data (monitoring, incidents, APM). This is corroborated by first-party docs, though there's no independent/hands-on validation of quality or breadth of these AI insights. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of Bits AI or Watchdog output quality, and detail on how comprehensive the 'insights' are across all product surfaces.
